about: Who ran each team in the 2022-2024 seasons. This is NOT part of the race dataset: it is a short reference list written by hand from public sources, which are linked on every entry. A title is given as it was published, because it is not always 'team principal' (Sauber had no team principal in 2023 and its leader was a 'team representative'; Williams's was also its CEO). Where a change happened part-way through a season, both people are listed for that season and the note says when. Only the seasons the site covers are given, so a tenure that began before 2022 or ended after 2024 is cut to those seasons.
